author: StoVuno
text:
Broadly speaking the "it's just software we can turn off at any time" argument doesn't really hold up, because there are many ways an AI can impact the physical world.

These include various cyber threats, human manipulation, and integration of AI systems with hardware (robots)

author: StoVuno
text:
Demis Hassabis is chomping at the bit to get his "Robotics models" into Boston Dynamics robots, for some reason.

I'm not saying those toddling shelf-stacking robots are going to destroy us all, but it's an example of AI being handed control of powerful hardware.
